name: course-management
description: StudySync Course Management - React + Express + MongoDB + Socket.IO

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix react-frontend install && npm --prefix mockapi install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix react-frontend run dev"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n mock,web -c yellow,green "npm --prefix mockapi start" "npm --prefix react-frontend run dev:mock"
